messages.content: Who invented the theory of relativity and in which year?

function.name: science_history_get_invention

message.content:
The theory of relativity was developed by **Albert Einstein**.  
- **Special Relativity** was first published in **1905** (the famous paper “On the Electrodynamics of Moving Bodies”).  
- **General Relativity**, the extension that incorporates gravitation, was completed and published in **1915**.
